business.about: Persistent Systems provides software engineering and strategy services to help companies implement and modernize their businesses. It has its own software and frameworks with pre-built integration and acceleration [1] . It also has partnership with providers such as Salesforce and AWS [2] .

results.read: Revenue +30% YoY; EBITDA margin compressed 550 bps YoY to 14% — the lowest in 9 quarters; PAT -25% — sales growth didn't reach the bottom line.

calls: Growth is decelerating: revenue CAGR 20.9% over 3y vs 28.6% over 5y
Margins expanding: 19% latest vs 17% average of prior years
Operating leverage: PAT compounding faster (26.5%) than revenue (20.9%)
Strong cash conversion: 5-yr operating cash flow is 1.01× reported profit
